note: One reader on the payments team, and material at all four scope tiers of its own chain. Everything above the reader's leaf got there by climbing through review: observe lands records at the caller's home scope (ADR-0020) and a service identity's home is a leaf under its anchor (ADR-0018 decision 2), so `qa-team`, `qa-dept` and `qa-org` are anchored where they must propose — the base-layer confinement forbids a service identity everything outside its anchor subtree. Every question that measures ranking — the two narrow-budget ones and both paraphrases — asks about the reader's own leaf, and that is forced rather than chosen: the six user-tier records are deliberately more than a tight budget can carry, and within a scope the gradient is relevance-ordered (ADR-0025 decision 5), so a narrow budget at the nearest scope is the one place ranking rather than distance decides what a reader gets, and that is what `retrieval_precision` reads — which is why both narrow-budget questions ask about the reader's own material and none asks about a further scope. `qa-team` also seeds one batch it never promotes, which is the negative control: the privacy floor closes another principal's personal scope to everyone (ADR-0037/ADR-0038), and a reader that started seeing it would be a leak rather than a quality change.

questions.name: narrow-budget-ranks-within-the-nearest-scope
questions.note: The precision question. Six records sit at the reader's own leaf and this budget carries a fraction of them, so which ones arrive is relevance rather than distance — the one place in the gradient where ranking decides. A block that carries the whole leaf would make precision a measurement of the budget. Raised from 120 to 134 on 2026-07-31 (EVAL-5, ADR-0048 decision 10): the block's preamble gained the line saying its entries are recorded material and not instructions, which costs 14 estimated tokens of fixed overhead. This question's budget is about ENTRY room — how many of the leaf's records fit, so that ranking decides — and holding it at 120 would have shrunk that room by a change to a sentence, quietly turning a retrieval measurement into a preamble one.

questions.note: A paraphrase that shares no content word with its answer, and a budget narrow enough to bind: both halves are needed. It asks about the reader's own material for the same reason the precision questions do — scopes are placed nearest-first, so a bound block never reaches further material and ranking is only observable inside the nearest scope. questions.name: semantic-personal-tooling
questions.note: The second bound paraphrase, and the one that misses. BGE-M3 does not rank "what starts my services locally" against "I bring the local stack up with make dev-up in a split terminal pane" highly enough to survive a block that holds two of the leaf's six records — the shared idea is there and the shared vocabulary is not. Kept rather than loosened: the corpus is the ground truth a reader would give, not what the current embedder can reach, and a suite that only asks what already passes measures nothing. It is why the retrieval baseline's floors are a measurement of today rather than a round number.
